correctness.rationale: Every endomorphism of the free class-two Lie algebra V⊕Λ²V has block data (A,B;0,Λ²A). For commuting idempotents the quotient A_i and center D_i=Λ²A_i have simultaneous binary weights; the exact sequence of modules for the semisimple product algebra F_q^{2^k} splits equivariantly, giving one central shear f with B_i=fA_i−D_if simultaneously, also in characteristic two. For eigenspace multiplicities n_c, center weight w_c counts unordered wedge pairs with bitwise AND c. The number of shear cosets is q^{n binom(n,2)−Σ_c n_c w_c}; GL_n-orbit counting yields T_{n,k}, the rank refinement, and signed-Stirling clique counts. Maximal families refine quotient to n lines and contain all subset projections; a centralizer of those line projections has no additional idempotents. Independent direct enumeration of all n=2 endomorphism (A,B) pairs over F_2 and F_3 gave (T_1,T_2)=(14,88) and (38,292), matching the theorem, but not a proof for arbitrary n.
